steps: Write the rate as a fraction: 108 km on top, 1 hour on the bottom. Then change one unit at a time.
Top: kilometers to meters is x 1000, so 108,000 m per hour. Bottom: one hour is 60 x 60 = 3600 seconds.
Divide: 108,000 / 3600 = 30 m/s. The shortcut for next time: km/h divided by 3.6.
Check the size. Far fewer meters fit in one second than in an hour. 389 m/s would beat the speed of sound.

choices.note: 108 / 3600 = 0.03 is the speed in kilometers per second. The meters never came in: multiply by 1000.
108,000 is meters per hour. The kilometers became meters, but the hour never became seconds. Divide by 3600.
108,000 / 60 = 1800 is meters per minute. One more divide by 60 reaches seconds.
108 x 3.6 = 388.8 multiplies by the shortcut. Meters per second is the smaller number, so divide by 3.6.
